title: Replay Vision async activities must evict stale Django DB connections first (track_activity)
answers: observation never gets a thumbnail after a database blip
async replay vision activity fails on first attempt after connection drop
where are stale db connections closed for replay vision temporal activities
connection already closed in async ORM call in temporal activity
body:
Symptom: after one dropped Postgres connection, an observation is left without a thumbnail for good. Every attempt of an async Replay Vision activity fails the same way, so retries don't help.
Root cause: products/replay_vision/backend/temporal/decorators.py:track_activity evicted stale connections only in the sync wrapper. Async ORM calls (e.g. `aget`) run on the same long-lived thread, so dead connections build up there too.
Fix pattern: async_wrapper now runs `await sync_to_async(close_stale_db_connections)()` (from posthog.temporal.common.utils) before calling the activity. This covers every async activity decorated with @track_activity.
Constraints: the eviction is skipped under `settings.TEST`, as close_db_connections already does, because it touches Django connections in tests that have no DB access. So no unit test covers it. New Replay Vision activities, sync or async, should use @track_activity to get this. Adding more retries does not replace the eviction.
applies: Temporal activities under products/replay_vision/backend/temporal that touch the Django ORM
